item.rlclones.clone_spawn_egg.tooltip: Summons a reinforcement-learning clone of you (same as the Z key)
rlclones.msg.no_permission: You are not allowed to control clones
rlclones.msg.link_on: Clone learning LINKED: %s clones now share one brain
rlclones.msg.link_off: Clone learning UNLINKED: every clone keeps learning on its own copy
rlclones.msg.respawn_off: Clone respawn: OFF (dead clones are gone for good)
rlclones.msg.unbound_social: [RL Clones] The vanilla 'Social Interactions' key was unbound so that P toggles clone respawn.
rlclones.cmd.policy: Learned combat policy (best action by distance):
rlclones.cmd.ai_off: %s stands still and only watches and learns
rlclones.reason.explosion: a creeper is about to explode
rlclones.reason.trapped: stuck in a hole and can't get out
rlclones.chat.resolved: [Resolved] X:%s Y:%s Z:%s is sorted out - no need to come any more!
rlclones.chat.cancel: [Cancelled] X:%s Y:%s Z:%s - I went down, don't come here.
rlclones.chat.hazard_learned: %s hurt me - remembering it as a harmful block and removing it.
rlclones.chat.loot: Looted the chest at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s: %s
rlclones.chat.withdraw: Took from the base chest at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s: %s
rlclones.chat.deposit: Stored in the base chest at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s: %s
rlclones.chat.base: New base at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s - everyone may use its chests%s
rlclones.chat.rally: [Rally] Meet at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s! Heading to unexplored land (X:%s Z:%s). %s more needed.
rlclones.chat.depart: Leaving with %s companion(s) - follow me! (to X:%s Z:%s)
rlclones.chat.join: I'll join %s's trip! On my way to X:%s Y:%s Z:%s
rlclones.chat.expedition_end: Expedition over at X:%s Z:%s - thanks, everyone is free again!
key.rlclones.teach_harmful: Teach clones: held block is harmful
rlclones.msg.teach_need_block: Hold a block to teach the clones that it is harmful
rlclones.msg.taught_harmful: %s taught %3$s clone(s): %2$s is a harmful block
rlclones.fact.spawn: full block: monsters can spawn on it
rlclones.fact.needstool: drops nothing without the right tool
rlclones.chat.rally_hunt: [Hunt] Meet at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s! We go to defeat %s (X:%s Z:%s). %s more needed.
rlclones.chat.hunt_end: Hunt over at X:%s Z:%s - thanks, everyone is free again!
rlclones.msg.br_on: BATTLE ROYALE! Every clone (%s) and every player is now everyone's enemy
rlclones.msg.br_off: Battle royale is over: teams as usual
rlclones.cmd.summoned_team: Summoned %s clone(s) for team %s (enemies of the other teams)
rlclones.chat.portal: I built a Nether portal at X:%s Y:%s Z:%s - who wants to see the Nether?
rlclones.msg.breeding_on: Breeding ON: well-fed clones (and players) with food to spare make new clones
rlclones.msg.chat_off: Clone chat hidden (clones still talk to each other)
rlclones.msg.breed_need: Both parents need a full food bar and at least %s food items
rlclones.chat.food: I'm starving and have nothing to eat! Please bring me some food (%s %s %s)
rlclones.cmd.gave_items: Gave %s clone(s) a random usable item each (no two the same)
